name: haki
display_name: Haki — long-term memory for AI agents
description: Self-hosted long-term memory for AI agents on your own Postgres. Facts are dated, versioned and superseded (never silently overwritten), every recall ships with an inspectable trace, and agents can correct wrong memories from inside the conversation. Five tools: haki_context, haki_capture, haki_inspect, haki_forget, haki_correct.

database_url.title: Postgres URL
database_url.description: asyncpg URL of your Haki database (schema applied via alembic): postgresql+asyncpg://user:pass@host:5432/haki

project_id.title: Project ID
project_id.description: Haki project this server instance reads and writes (e.g. prj_myapp)

org_id.title: Org ID
org_id.description: Haki organization the project belongs to (e.g. org_default)

subject_id.title: Subject ID
subject_id.description: Subject whose memory this server instance serves (one instance per person/agent)
